# Press state and assembly

Follow [the editorial contract](../../../docs/editorial-contract.md) and [review template](../../../templates/review.state.md). Record canonical_draft, reviewed_revision, scope, outcome, proposed metadata, unresolved risks and next action in press.state.md when persistence is available.

Inspect selected reviews against the current draft revision. Missing or stale reviews cannot be passed by label. Devil, Echo and Prism are not mandatory dependencies; document any deliberate skips and their scope. No Pass/CLEAR string search constitutes approval.

When asked to assemble a package, use the destination schema from authorized private packaging guidelines. Preserve the canonical body exactly, use the author's selected metadata, omit irrelevant image fields, and keep draft: true where supported. Create {slug}.md only if it is a distinct requested output; never overwrite a canonical publication source accidentally. Do not publish, merge or deploy.
